description: Looks up objects by name or identifier (English or French, accents optional): planets, moons, missions beyond Earth orbit, featured science satellites, any active Earth satellite (by name, NORAD or COSPAR id), landing and launch sites, named stars. Returns ids for the other tools.

query.description: Name or identifier to look up, e.g. "ISS", "Voyager 1", "25544", "Mars", "Apollo 11".

name: perigee_find
title: Find an object
